verdict.rationale: LocalAI can pull models directly via `ollama://` and `huggingface://` URIs and uses standard GGUF files, implying some cross-runtime compatibility, but there is no explicit documentation confirming it reuses an existing Ollama/other runtime's local cache or model directory without re-downloading or re-converting. missing for 10: explicit statement on shared cache/model directory reuse, evidence of avoiding re-download when another runtime already has the file, and independent confirmation of format interoperability.
